Arena assistant files QA — 2026-10-29

Base: 413490abf (0.4.0-beta.15). macOS Electron development stack and Chromium QA harness.
[AI] Replayed the existing collapsed/expanded local PNGs with explicit Markdown image links in an isolated archived battle; both images rendered. Opened Agent A notes.txt:2 and observed its own worktree's file at line 2. Screenshot: desktop.png.
The original saved reply contained captions only, so this is a reconstructed reply using the saved images, not a fresh model-generated battle. Production data was not modified.
[automated] The regression uses a real isolated daemon, Arena archive store, browser, file RPCs, and separate Git worktrees. It covers relative and file:// images, missing-image errors, explicit and inline-code file links, line targets, and reload.
[automated] The same regression fails with run-thread.tsx restored from the base commit: ./preview.png is treated as https://./preview.png and Image a never becomes visible. The fixed renderer was restored after that run.
[automated] The legacy JSDOM renderer suite fails before test collection with Unexpected token 'typeof' on both the fixed and original renderer; no legacy unit pass is claimed.
Not tested: fresh provider inference, voting this synthetic replay, packaged release, Windows, Linux, or performance profiling.

Raw command output follows. Checkout and temporary home paths are redacted; ANSI styling and trailing spaces are removed.
